figures.finding: Tanzania publishes no production rebate; what a producer pays the Film Board instead is a filming permit: TZS 50,000 for a Tanzanian's first to fifth film, TZS 500,000 for a producer with more than five films or a sponsored film, TZS 2,000,000 for a commercial, plus an annual operating licence (TZS 200,000 for a studio, TZS 500,000 for a cinema); foreign productions apply at least a month before shooting.
figures.applies: Tanzania, as published by the Film Board 2025-2026.

sources.said: Ada: Kwa watanzania/filamu za kitanzania ni: TZS. 50,000 (Utayarishaji filamu ya kwanza hadi ya Tano) TZS. 500,000 (Mtayarishaji mwenye zaidi ya filamu Tano na filamu zilizofadhiliwa) TZS. 2,000,000 (Utayarishaji wa matangazo ya Kibiashara)
Kumbi za sinema: TZS. 500,000 kwa mwaka Maeneo ya uzalishaji kama studios: TZS. 200,000 Maeneo mengine: TZS. 36,000 Ada hii inalipwa kwa mwaka.
Waombaji wote wanashauriwa kuwasilisha fomu hiyo Bodi ya Filamu Tanzania angalau mwezi mmoja kabla ya kuanza shughuli za upigaji picha.
